description: Task-owned constrained run/document/chunk/attempt schema. Atomic preparation/success/retry transactions. Dedicated advisory-lock session; stop scheduling on loss; fence commits. Test crashes, integrity, explicit retry.

comments.text: Action reuse assessment: ordinary Ingestion IngestJob/IngestChunkJob track production Oban jobs and retry semantics, but do not own an isolated benchmark run, source hashes, owner generation or stale-worker fencing. Ecto Repo transactions and PostgreSQL advisory locks are the relevant primitives. Decision: local-only benchmark Checkpoint/Lease persistence boundary; no new Action or agent tool because calls are internal runner lifecycle steps and must share one held corpus DB session. Inputs: run/config/source identity, prepared chunk payloads, owner lease, result/failure; outputs: constrained state and fixed errors, no actor-facing API; side effects confined to corpus DB, explicit retries only. Tests: atomic preparation/success/rollback, uniqueness, crash/reacquire, lock contention, stale lease rejection, no secret/provider body persistence.

Implemented dedicated constrained checkpoint migration and Ecto schemas; session advisory lock with persisted generation/token and stale-owner checks; atomic document preparation, vector+checkpoint success, redacted failure, explicit retry, and completion transactions. Verified 8 focused ExUnit tests covering resume, crash/reacquire, idempotence/conflict, vector rollback, duplicate success refusal, redaction, retry, stale commit. mix q passes. Corpus schema setup and runner integration remain in zaq-f9w.6.
